bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears enter Sunday's Week 11 matchup against the New Orleans Saints coming off their bye week as a 7-2 team, but they will be without starting slot cornerback Kyler Gordon, who was ruled out after missing all three days of practice this week with a shoulder injury. Meanwhile, defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons was limited again in practice but intends to play on Sunday as he downplays the Bears' injury report.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Lions officially placed star edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve while activating safety Kerby Joseph ahead of their Week 11 matchup against the Buccaneers. With Hutchinson sidelined, Detroit is also expected to debut rookie Ahmed Hassanein and is leaning on other defenders to help fill the void left by Hutchinson's injury.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: Matt LaFleur cast doubt on Josh Jacobs' return for Green Bay's Week 12 matchup against the Rams, as the Packers face a Week 12 backfield question after LaFleur cast doubt on Jacobs' return, with the team returning to practice Saturday for the Wednesday game against Los Angeles . Meanwhile, there's positive news on the defensive side, as LaFleur says Micah Parsons' practice performance will determine whether the star pass rusher returns against the Rams, with the head coach needing to see enough in practice to put him on the field .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings are dealing with injury concerns ahead of their upcoming matchup, with starting cornerback Isaiah Rodgers banged up and rookie Charles Demmings potentially stepping in, while Kyler Murray's status also continues to be monitored amid a hamstring issue. On the field, the team has been riding momentum after a dominant win over Green Bay following Kirk Cousins' return, though they'll need to navigate the second half of the season while managing injuries to key contributors like Jordan Addison.
